claims.claim: Common Crawl WARC records preserve raw crawl records including HTTP responses, requests and crawl metadata.
claims.locator: Get Started, Data Types / The WARC Format
claims.notes: WARC files contain multiple records; do not equate one file with one page.

claims.claim: WAT contains JSON metadata derived from WARC records, including HTTP headers and HTML link metadata.
claims.notes: WAT is metadata, not the complete HTML payload.

claims.claim: WET is a WARC Encapsulated Text view that stores extracted plaintext for text-oriented use cases.
claims.notes: Plaintext extraction does not imply main-content or boilerplate quality.

claims.claim: The Common Crawl URL Index Server supports CDX URL-index queries for crawl archives.
claims.locator: Index Server landing page and API guidance
claims.notes: Bulk domain-scale work should use the appropriate columnar/offline index rather than overloading the URL query service.

claims.claim: In FineWeb's ablation, WET retained too much boilerplate and menu text compared with Trafilatura extraction from WARC; the WARC-based extraction performed better in that experimental setup.
claims.locator: FineWeb paper, §3.2 Text extraction and Figure 1
claims.notes: Specific to the paper's extraction pipeline, model, token budget and evaluation setup; not a universal extractor ranking.
